# get_potential_near_atoms { #mofography.visualize.get_potential_near_atoms }

```python
visualize.get_potential_near_atoms(
    atoms,
    potential,
    grid_shape,
    element='Zn',
    radius=1.0,
)
```

Get potential values near atoms of a specific element.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type   | Description                                    | Default    |
|------------|--------|------------------------------------------------|------------|
| atoms      |        | ASE Atoms object                               | _required_ |
| potential  |        | 3D array of potential values                   | _required_ |
| grid_shape |        | Shape of the potential grid                    | _required_ |
| element    |        | Element symbol to look for                     | `'Zn'`     |
| radius     |        | Radius around the atom to check (in Angstroms) | `1.0`      |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                       |
|--------|--------|---------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | List of potential values near the specified atoms |
